protocol.threshold_selection: One threshold minimizing pooled F7-F9 OOF errors, frozen before F10-F12
protocol.rounds_selection: Median early-stopping best rounds from F7-F9; no test early stopping
protocol.raw_minimal: Original numeric values stay numeric; text values receive training-only integer codes; missing values stay NaN. No custom type classification or feature deletion.

limitations: F7-F9 metrics select preprocessing, hyperparameters, rounds, and thresholds, so they are selection scores. Earlier project work already inspected some F10-F12 months; this comparison is exploratory. Preprocessing feature roles come from the existing unsupervised type map. It is not a measurement of the unavailable June-November 2024 target data.
